question: How is the constant washing of the mouth symbolically identified in this teaching?
premises: Washing of the mouth is to be done always
It is described as having gone upward
inference: The constant washing of the mouth is identified as the upward movement of Brahman
uncertainties: Esoteric meaning of ūrddha-gatam in this ritual context
plain_english: O beloved, the constant washing of the mouth is the upward movement of Brahman.
